Originally posted by riolotv:
what of it is done with ai?

Music and art, but it doesn't matter WHAT it was used for, but that AI was used regardless.

"AI Generated Content Disclosure
The developers describe how their game uses AI Generated Content like this:

Generative AI was used during the initial production of character and background artwork to explore different visual concepts, expressions, poses, and compositions.

All character and background artwork is manually refined and finalized, including adjustments to poses, colors, details, character consistency, and overall visual quality.

Generative AI was also used to create the game's background music. All AI-assisted content is pre-generated during development; no generative AI content is created during gameplay."
